steps_items.text: After completing Granite PM Academy's course, submit your formal application to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam fee at that time. Our team provides guidance on the application process so your submission meets PMI's verification standards.

Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to support your ongoing credential maintenance.
